traps: FMA distinguishes Left and Right classes; Uberon and SNOMED often have one bilateral class. A left rib maps to FMA 'Left first rib' but has no Uberon or SNOMED id through this chain.
A segmentation label is a name, not a class: 'iliac_artery' may cover more than FMA 'Common iliac artery'. Extent was not checked, so those claims are S.
The OLS4 search tool returns classes, not meanings. An exact label hit proves the class exists (C); it does not prove the mesh is that structure (L at best).
Wikidata P1402 values are bare numbers (7197), the FMA IRI uses fma7197, BodyParts3D uses FMA7197. The builder normalises all three.
